purpose: Teach: カーター/ジョブズ/ナイジェリア/アルメニア/プラトン/ユング/ラテンアメリカ/ローマ法王

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、カーター元大統領の伝記を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi mentioned that customer was reading a biography of former President Carter.
lines.style: Soft, musing tone. Sharing an observation without urgency. Quiet admiration in the voice — noticing something about the customer. Gentle pacing, like she's turning the thought over.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ジョブズの伝記がご趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer really loves reading Jobs' biography, apparently.
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost conversational. A small smile in the voice. Not stating fact but gently noting what she's picked up. Warm, wondering tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ナイジェリアへ取材に行かれるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: I heard that customer went on assignment to Nigeria.
lines.style: Quiet interest. Slight lift on 'Nigeria' — a moment of real curiosity breaking through. Soft but present. Not pressing for details, just noting something significant.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、アルメニアのワインを取り寄せてらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer ordered Armenian wine specially, didn't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost delighted by the detail. Warm observation. Pace slightly slower — lingering on the specificity. Noticing care in small choices.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、プラトンの対話篇を読書中だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer's been reading Plato's dialogues, I think.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective tone. Soft pause before 'Plato's' — a moment of recognition. Wondering admiration underneath. Not presumptuous, just gently noting.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ユング心理学を学ばれてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi says that customer is studying Jungian psychology.
lines.style: Gentle curiosity in the voice. Slight lean forward in attention. Warm but measured — respecting the depth of what the customer is doing. Thoughtful pacing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ラテンアメリカ音楽がご趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer has a real love for Latin American music.
lines.style: Soft warmth. A note of appreciation for the taste. Unhurried delivery. Noticing something genuine about the person, not just their orders.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ローマ法王のミサに出席されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi told me that customer actually attended a papal Mass.
lines.style: Quiet awe underneath. Gentle, almost reverent pacing. A moment of real wonder — not exclaiming, just letting the weight of it settle. Soft, warm close.
